name: Crypto vs Treasury Yield Correlation Analysis
description:
Analyze the relationship between major cryptocurrency price changes (BTC, ETH) and US 10-Year Treasury yield changes. This study examines how crypto assets respond to interest rate movements through:

- **Correlation analysis**: Calculate rolling correlations between crypto returns and yield changes
- **Scatter plots**: Visualize the relationship between crypto returns and yield changes
- **Time series comparison**: Compare crypto returns vs yield changes over time
- **Summary statistics**: Key metrics including average correlation, return statistics, and relationship strength
source:
# Crypto vs Treasury Yield Correlation Analysis
# Analyze relationship between BTC/ETH price changes and US 10Y Treasury yield changes

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# =============================================================================

# Primary asset data (BTC)
src = market_data_source()()
close_btc = src.c

# ETH as reference crypto
eth_src = common_crypto_pairs(ticker=ReferenceCryptoPair.ETHUSD)()
close_eth = eth_src.c

# US 10-Year Treasury Yield (FRED data)
treasury_obs_date, treasury_10y, treasury_rev = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury10Y)()

# Forward fill Treasury yield to align with daily crypto bars
treasury_10y_filled = ffill(treasury_10y)

# VIX Index from FRED (CBOE Volatility Index)
vix_data = economic_indicators(series_id='VIXCLS', use_alfred=False)()
vix_close = ffill(vix_data.result)

# =============================================================================
# CALCULATE RETURNS AND CHANGES
# =============================================================================

# Daily returns for crypto (as decimal fractions)
btc_returns = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.simple)(close_btc)
eth_returns = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.simple)(close_eth)

# Daily change in Treasury yield (difference, not percentage)
yield_change = treasury_10y_filled - (treasury_10y_filled >> 1)

# Daily change in VIX (difference)
vix_change = vix_close - (vix_close >> 1)

# =============================================================================
# ROLLING CORRELATIONS
# =============================================================================

# 60-day rolling correlation between crypto returns and yield changes
corr_btc_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=btc_returns, y=yield_change)
corr_eth_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=eth_returns, y=yield_change)

# 30-day rolling for shorter-term view
corr_btc_30d = rolling_corr(window=30, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=btc_returns, y=yield_change)
corr_eth_30d = rolling_corr(window=30, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=eth_returns, y=yield_change)

# Full-period expanding correlation
corr_btc_full = rolling_corr(window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=btc_returns, y=yield_change)
corr_eth_full = rolling_corr(window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=eth_returns, y=yield_change)

# =============================================================================
# VIX CORRELATIONS
# =============================================================================

# 60-day rolling correlation between crypto returns and VIX changes
corr_btc_vix_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=btc_returns, y=vix_change)
corr_eth_vix_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=eth_returns, y=vix_change)

# Full-period expanding correlation with VIX
corr_btc_vix_full = rolling_corr(window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=btc_returns, y=vix_change)
corr_eth_vix_full = rolling_corr(window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=eth_returns, y=vix_change)

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY STATISTICS
# =============================================================================

# Volatility of returns and yield changes
btc_vol = stddev(period=60)(btc_returns)
eth_vol = stddev(period=60)(eth_returns)
yield_vol = stddev(period=60)(yield_change)
vix_vol = stddev(period=60)(vix_change)

# Index for time series charts
idx = index()()

# =============================================================================
# REGIME ANALYSIS: Yields Rising + VIX Rising vs Other Regimes
# =============================================================================

# Define regime conditions (using 5-day smoothed changes to reduce noise)
yield_change_smooth = ma(period=5, type=MAType.sma)(yield_change)
vix_change_smooth = ma(period=5, type=MAType.sma)(vix_change)

# Regime flags
yields_rising = yield_change_smooth > 0
vix_rising = vix_change_smooth > 0

# Four regimes
regime_both_rising = yields_rising and vix_rising           # Risk-off: rates up, fear up
regime_yields_up_vix_down = yields_rising and not vix_rising  # Growth optimism
regime_yields_down_vix_up = not yields_rising and vix_rising  # Flight to safety
regime_both_falling = not yields_rising and not vix_rising    # Risk-on: rates down, calm

# Regime labels (1-4 for categorization)
regime_label = 1 if regime_both_rising else (2 if regime_yields_up_vix_down else (3 if regime_yields_down_vix_up else 4))

# =============================================================================
# VISUALIZATIONS
# =============================================================================

# --- Summary Cards ---
cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="Correlation Summary",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="BTC-Yield Avg Corr", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="ETH-Yield Avg Corr", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Current BTC Corr", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Current ETH Corr", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category="Summary"
)(corr_btc_60d, corr_eth_60d, corr_btc_60d, corr_eth_60d)

# Additional stats cards
cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="Yield Statistics",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg Yield Change (bps)", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Yield Change Vol", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title="BTC Return Vol", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="ETH Return Vol", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Summary"
)(yield_change, yield_vol, btc_vol, eth_vol)

# VIX Summary Cards
cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="VIX Statistics",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Current VIX", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg VIX Level", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg VIX Change", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="VIX Change Vol", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category="VIX Analysis"
)(vix_close, vix_close, vix_change, vix_vol)

# VIX Correlation Cards
cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="VIX-Crypto Correlations",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="BTC-VIX Avg Corr", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="ETH-VIX Avg Corr", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Current BTC-VIX Corr", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Current ETH-VIX Corr", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category="VIX Analysis"
)(corr_btc_vix_60d, corr_eth_vix_60d, corr_btc_vix_60d, corr_eth_vix_60d)

# --- Rolling Correlation Time Series ---
xy_lines(
    title="Rolling 60-Day Correlation: Crypto Returns vs Treasury Yield Changes",
    category="Correlation Analysis",
    x_axis_label="Date",
    y_axis_label="Correlation",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="BTC vs 10Y Yield", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="ETH vs 10Y Yield", color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero")
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(corr_btc_60d, corr_eth_60d))

# --- Full Period Expanding Correlation ---
xy_lines(
    title="Expanding (Cumulative) Correlation Over Time",
    category="Correlation Analysis",
    x_axis_label="Date",
    y_axis_label="Correlation",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="BTC Full Period", color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="ETH Full Period", color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero")
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(corr_btc_full, corr_eth_full))

# --- Scatter Plot: Yield Changes vs Crypto Returns ---
labeled_scatter(
    title="Crypto Returns vs Treasury Yield Changes",
    category="Scatter Analysis",
    x_axis_label="10Y Yield Daily Change (%)",
    y_axis_label="Crypto Daily Return",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label="BTC", color=Color.Orange, x_agg=AggregationType.Mean, y_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
        LabeledPointSpec(label="ETH", color=Color.Blue, x_agg=AggregationType.Mean, y_agg=AggregationType.Mean)
    ]),
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero Return")
    ]),
    order=1
)(yield_change, btc_returns, yield_change, eth_returns)

# --- Time Series Comparison: Returns vs Yield Changes ---
xy_lines(
    title="Daily Returns & Yield Changes Comparison",
    category="Time Series Comparison",
    x_axis_label="Date",
    y_axis_label="Value",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="BTC Daily Return", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="ETH Daily Return", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="10Y Yield Change (scaled)", color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title="Zero")
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(btc_returns, eth_returns, yield_change))

# --- Return Distribution Comparison ---
histogram(
    title="BTC Daily Return Distribution",
    category="Return Distributions",
    bins=50,
    x_axis_label="Daily Return",
    y_axis_label="Frequency",
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    fill_color=Color.Orange,
    fill_opacity=0.7
)(value=btc_returns)

histogram(
    title="ETH Daily Return Distribution",
    category="Return Distributions",
    bins=50,
    x_axis_label="Daily Return",
    y_axis_label="Frequency",
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.7
)(value=eth_returns)

# --- 30-Day vs 60-Day Rolling Correlation Comparison ---
xy_lines(
    title="BTC-Yield Correlation: 30-Day vs 60-Day Rolling",
    category="Correlation Windows",
    x_axis_label="Date",
    y_axis_label="Correlation",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="30-Day Rolling", color=Color.Amber),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="60-Day Rolling", color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero")
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(corr_btc_30d, corr_btc_60d))

xy_lines(
    title="ETH-Yield Correlation: 30-Day vs 60-Day Rolling",
    category="Correlation Windows",
    x_axis_label="Date",
    y_axis_label="Correlation",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="30-Day Rolling", color=Color.Cyan),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="60-Day Rolling", color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero")
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(corr_eth_30d, corr_eth_60d))
